en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Umayya Bin Amro, from Al Shaeeri, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Extinguish the fires of the grudges with the meat and Al-Sareyd’.
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Umayyah ibn ‘Amr from al-Shu’ayriy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must extinguish the flame of malice with meat and Tharid (bread in broth).’”
